description: This Java class represents a domain entity called JobParameter used to persist and manage parameters associated with jobs in the system. It includes fields for job ID, parameter name, and parameter value, with utility methods for instantiation and equality checks.

classes.name: JobParameter
classes.description: Entity class for job parameters, extending AbstractPersistableCustom, with fields for job ID, parameter name, and parameter value, along with utility methods.
